QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states only that MBEDTLS_THREADING_C is commented out in the shipped header; it never says the second threading macro (PTHREAD/ALT) is also undefined, and it mentions THREADING_ALT and THREADING_PTHREAD only as an index build flag and an alternative, not as defaults.
